title: Two-dimensional linear-static cantilever
purpose: Exercise the model-first linear elasticity path, strong support, boundary traction, K/F system construction, PETSc solve, AF-IR export, and XDMF output.
physics: small-strain isotropic linear elasticity in plane strain

execution.evidence: The example must solve without validation errors and write finite displacement results plus an AF-IR record.

observables: All displacement degrees of freedom are finite.
The fixed boundary remains at the prescribed displacement.
The displacement magnitude is nonzero under nonzero traction.
The result and AF-IR files are written by rank zero.
acceptance: The example exits successfully in the tested FEniCSx environment.
Model validation contains no errors before solve.
The output can be opened as an XDMF finite-element field.
limitations: This is currently an executable integration smoke test, not a mesh-convergence or analytical-error benchmark.
A future benchmark revision should compare tip displacement and reaction against beam theory and a converged two-dimensional reference.
